content-humanizer 1.0.0

- Initial release of the content-humanizer skill for transforming AI-generated writing into authentic, brand-specific human copy.
- Includes a three-mode process: Detect AI patterns, Humanize tone and rhythm, and Inject brand voice.
- Provides a comprehensive checklist for identifying common AI writing tells.
- Guides users to gather context and examples to accurately match brand personality.
- Not intended for initial content creation or SEO optimization—focuses solely on revitalizing robotic or generic drafts.
